label.en: Quant Data Intern · Web Scraping / ETL / Python Data Engineering
label.zh: 量化数据实习生 · Web Scraping / ETL / Python 数据工程

highlights.en: Contributed to the Global EV Data Initiative: multi-source collection, cleaning and validation of global EV charging-station data, producing standardized datasets and a web visualization platform.
highlights.zh: 参与 Global EV Data Initiative：负责全球 EV 充电站**多源数据采集、清洗与校核**，产出标准化数据集并搭建 Web 可视化平台。

highlights.en: Built a SHP → GeoJSON processing pipeline with GeoPandas and an interactive distribution / statistics dashboard using Leaflet / Chart.js.
highlights.zh: 基于 GeoPandas 构建 SHP → GeoJSON 数据处理流程，结合 Leaflet / Chart.js 实现分布与统计的交互式仪表盘。

highlights.en: Built in-house data-collection tooling to support vision-model training; enterprise RAG data pipeline: document parsing → embedding → retrieval → answer (BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen), deployed with Docker.
highlights.zh: 开发内部数据采集工具，为视觉模型训练提供数据支持；企业级 RAG 数据链路：文档解析 → 向量化 → 检索 → 问答（BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen），Docker 部署。

highlights.en: Led a real-time industrial vision system: multi-stream inference with DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT, 32 concurrent RTSP feeds, two-stage detection plus an alert state machine.
highlights.zh: 主导实时工业视觉系统：DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT 多路推理，32 路 RTSP 并发，两阶段检测 + 告警状态机。
